description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'LeaveEntitlementServiceTest' for the 'LeaveEntitlementService' component of an HR management system plugin. It includes multiple test methods verifying behavior related to leave entitlement strategies, DAO interactions, leave balance calculations, entitlement creation, and bulk operations, along with some mock strategy classes and fixture loading.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlementServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test suite for testing the LeaveEntitlementService's functionalities, including strategy retrieval, DAO interactions, leave balance calculations, entitlement creation, and bulk operations. Also includes mock strategy classes for testing purposes.

classes.name: TestEntitlementConsumptionStrategy
classes.description: A mock implementation of EntitlementConsumptionStrategy used for testing, with stub methods returning default values.

classes.name: InvalidLeaveEntitlementConsumptionStrategy
classes.description: A placeholder class representing an invalid strategy implementation for testing class type errors.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case with a new instance of LeaveEntitlementService.

methods.name: testGetLeaveEntitlementStrategy
methods.description: Verifies that the strategy returned by getLeaveEntitlementStrategy is an instance of EntitlementConsumptionStrategy when a valid class is configured.

methods.name: testGetLeaveEntitlementStrategyNonExistClass
methods.description: Tests the behavior when the configured class does not exist, expecting an Error exception.

methods.name: testGetLeaveEntitlementStrategyInvalidClass
methods.description: Tests the behavior when the configured class does not implement the expected interface, expecting a TypeError.

methods.name: testGetLeaveEntitlementDao
methods.description: Confirms that getLeaveEntitlementDao returns an instance of LeaveEntitlementDao.

methods.name: testGetDeletableIdsFromEntitlementIds
methods.description: Checks that getDeletableIdsFromEntitlementIds filters entitlement IDs correctly based on whether days used is zero.

methods.name: getDeletableIdsFromEntitlementIdsDataProvider
methods.description: Provides various datasets for testing ID filtering logic.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceWithDates
methods.description: Verifies leave balance retrieval given specific employee number, leave type, and date range.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceWithOnlyEndDate
methods.description: Tests leave balance retrieval when only the end date is specified.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceWithOnlyAsAtDate
methods.description: Checks leave balance retrieval when using only the 'as at' date with different leave period statuses.

methods.name: testGetLeaveBalanceWithOnlyAsAtDateLeavePeriodNotForced
methods.description: Confirms correct behavior when leave period status is not forced, ensuring strategy is not called.

methods.name: testAddEntitlementForEmployeeAsNew
methods.description: Tests adding entitlement for an employee who previously had no entitlement; verifies credited date and amount.

methods.name: testAddEntitlementForEmployeeAsAdding
methods.description: Tests adding entitlement for an employee with existing entitlement; ensures no duplication.

methods.name: testAddEntitlementForEmployeeAsAddingWhenDeletedAlsoThere
methods.description: Verifies entitlement addition when previous entitlement was marked as deleted, should create new entitlement.

methods.name: testBulkAssignLeaveEntitlements
methods.description: Checks bulk assignment of leave entitlements to multiple employees.

methods.name: loadFixtures
methods.description: Loads test data fixtures into the database for setup.
